history.content: Is anything going to collide next week?

What the calendar does show is all this week: BigCo interview today at 2, dentist tomorrow at 9, then standup and dinner with Dana on Wednesday. Those don't overlap with each other either. Two caveats: I only looked at your calendar, so anything that lives in email threads or reminders wouldn't show up here. And if you meant "next week" loosely as the rest of this week, that's the Mon, Wed run above, clear of conflicts. Want me to sweep your mail for anything scheduled that never made it onto the calendar?
